messages:
alex: Dropping two headline options + hero and an embed mock for the launch post. Need copy + legal + ops sign-off before I lock. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/2-launch-draft-hero.
michelle: will do legal pass. quick q: any performance claim in the hero? I see "low-latency inference at 40ms median" in variant A. need bench details to approve.
brian: product note: variant B emphasizes cost per 1k tokens. both fine but we should A/B test hero for CTR. also confirm the model/config behind 40ms.
alex: variant A hero: "Low-latency inference for real-time apps (median 40ms).*"
variant B hero: "Cut inference cost by up to 3x for typical chat workloads."
embed mock: <iframe src="/bench-visuals/latency-plot.html" width=600 height=320>

tina: for lead routing: recommend 1) HubSpot form with hidden field `product_interest=redwood_inference_launch`; 2) add UTM params; 3) for webinar invites tag `early_access` and send to nurture list.
sam_ops: routing ack. confirm we want leads to go to pipeline `launch-nurture` for 3 days then to `sdr-unassigned`? also confirm region-based routing (NA/EU/APAC).
alex: yes region-based routing pls. default to NA. tina can you paste the UTM string?
tina: UTM for primary CTA:
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=may_launch&utm_term=heroA&utm_content=register_cta&product_interest=redwood_inference_launch
```
include `hs_prefix` so analytics can pick it up.
michelle: legal needs the bench command and date. Also add a footnote: "Internal benchmark on 2026-03-25; not independently audited." Avoid absolutes like "up to 3x" unless we specify the workload where that applies.
brian: benchmark details: model: rwd-large-q4, baseline: model-x, seq=128, batch=4, hw=p4d, runs=200. median 40ms vs baseline 125ms (~3.1x). I'll paste the exact command in the doc.
alex: pasted bench command under methods section:
```
./bench_tool --model rwd-large-q4 --baseline model-x --seq 128 --batch 4 --hw p4d --runs 200 --seed 7
```
results: median 40ms vs 125ms (3.125x).
michelle: ok legal thumbs up after we reword B hero to: "Reduces inference cost for chat workloads in our tests" and add the footnote. No superlatives.
alex: updated variant B to "Reduces inference cost for chat workloads in our tests."
tina: one more for tracking: add hidden field `lead_source=launch_blog_v1` and set lifecycle stage `marketing_qualified` when they register for the webinar. Also add `utm_term` mapping in HubSpot.
sam_ops: publish scheduling: what date/time? alex?
alex: aim to publish May 4 at 09:00 PT. embargo until publish. @publish-bot can you schedule?
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-05-04T16:00:00Z. embargo flag set. will ping #press and #social on release.
brian: webinar logistics: live demo + Q&A May 12 11am PT. limit to 150 seats, early-access priority. Tina will coordinate invites.
tina: noted. I'll create the segmented invite: early-access customers + signups in last 30 days, then open registration if seats remain.
michelle: legal final: approved 44d with bench footnote and reworded claims.
abex: (typo) alex: locking doc for edits EOD tomorrow and will follow up for final go/no-go. thanks all.
